status: DRAFT v1, 8 Nov 2026. Land shares: MoA&FW Land Use Statistics 2023-24 (provisional), reporting area. People and villages: Census 2011. The two bases are never combined.
format: F10 Paradox (G1 Why (Almost) Nobody Lives Here, inverted: almost no land lies idle)
title: Only 1 Hectare in 18 of Kerala Lies Idle. India: 1 in 5

beats.say: In Kerala, in south-west India, only about one hectare in eighteen lies idle.
beats.caption: Kerala: about 1 hectare in 18 lies idle · 2023-24 (provisional)

beats.say: Across India, it is about one in five.
beats.caption: All India: about 1 in 5 (21.0%) · Kerala: 5.6%

beats.say: In twenty eleven, Kerala packed eight hundred and sixty people into each square kilometre.
beats.caption: Census 2011: 860 people per km²

beats.say: That census found just one village in Kerala where nobody lived.
beats.caption: Census 2011: 1 uninhabited village · 1,017 inhabited

beats.say: In ten years, land under buildings, roads and water grew sixteen percent.
beats.caption: Non-agricultural uses: +16% · 2014-15 to 2023-24 (p)

beats.say: Over a quarter is classed as forest, a legal label, wooded or not.
beats.caption: 27.8% classed as forest (a legal class) · 2023-24 (p)

beats.say: Still, Punjab and West Bengal have even less idle land.
beats.caption: Idle land, 2023-24 (p): Punjab 3.0% · West Bengal 3.5%

beats.say: But in Kerala, only about one hectare in eighteen lies idle.
beats.caption: Kerala: about 1 in 18 idle · India: about 1 in 5
